name: ostrich
description: Create a deliberate hard cut from unwanted work by choosing and leading one maximally unrelated tangent, with cautious local preference learning.

interface.shortDescription: Escape work through one fresh tangent
interface.longDescription: Create a deliberate hard cut from overwhelming or unwanted work. Ostrich silently excludes the active work cluster, chooses one distant and engaging tangent without presenting a menu, grounds factual claims when needed, and learns broad preferences without retaining the work context that prompted the escape.
